tagline: One invite is the table. Draw, pass, guess — no game server.
description:
Send the invite. Everyone who opens it sits at the same table. There is no game server and no code to type: the invite is the room, and every round lives in this file.

Someone draws a word. The next person guesses. The next person draws that guess. Around it goes until a cat has become a hat. There is no winning. The point is the chain.

Or pass this device around a table. Add names, start, and hand the phone to whoever is up. A splash hides the last turn so nobody peeks. Draw with a finger or a mouse.

An unofficial port of Drawphone by Tanner Krewson. The original needs a game server. This copy does not.
